author: CBR
description:
Anthony Mackie breaks down the wild story behind becoming Falcon in the MCU, from taking a mystery Marvel role to filming his first big action scene with Anthony Russo. 

Before Sam Wilson became one of the MCU’s most important heroes, Mackie says Marvel wouldn’t even tell him which character he was playing!

author: CBR
description:
Robert Downey Jr. surprised Marvel fans at the Avengers: Infinity War panel at SXSW London, joking that he “used to play Tony” before reflecting on why Infinity War still hits so hard. 

RDJ also discussed Thanos, Doctor Doom, and Marvel “zeroing out the board” to earn fans’ trust all over again.
